brand: VCCI — Liên đoàn Thương mại và Công nghiệp Việt Nam / Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry

geometry_relative_to_cap_height_H.note: Drum and first C share one centre; a fine ring of background separates them.

logo.clear_space_x: x = drum radius = 0.262 H on all sides
logo.plate_padding: x on all sides, Paper #FBF9F4, corner radius ≈ 0.03 H
rules: One colourway only: VCCI Blue letters + drum in master colours, on light grounds.
On blue, dark, photographic or busy grounds: place the logo on a Paper plate.
Never white letters (cultural rule), never gold letters, never a standalone drum as a logo substitute.
Never stretch, rotate, recolour, add effects, or redraw the logo.
The drum SVG in _Construction-only is for construction drawings and pattern design only.

colour.rule: One gold gesture per composition (a rule, a word, or a gold accent shape).

scale.label: Be Vietnam Pro SemiBold 12, uppercase, tracking +22%

C-arc pattern (the first C as a ring cut at +0.35R)
